name: print-social-december-business-calendar-post-on-tilted-notepad-card
title: 'December Business & Marketing Calendar' post with a tilted notepad card, flag ribbon and paperclip
whatItIs: A square pale-blue post with logo and author avatar, a bold 'December' title and italic blue subtitle, and a slightly tilted white notepad card with punch holes, a blue ribbon tag, and ruled lines listing dates, events and hashtags (#AnnualPlanning), finished with a paperclip.
whatItMeans: Handy and personable; the notepad metaphor makes a list feel like a saved planner.
techniques: Present a list on a tilted paper card.
Add a ribbon tag for the theme.
Use a paperclip as a realistic touch.
Pair each item with a hashtag.

vocabulary.definition: Imitating real objects like paper or clips.
